resources.string: SmsOfLife
TEMPORARY DEVICE RECOVERY
Inspect the pending SMS queue
Malformed WAP Push messages left in the Android SMS queue may be associated with repeated phone-service crashes. Inspect queue metadata without opening message contents.

Scanning uses SMS read access. Some devices also require the temporary SMS role to return a cursor. Deleting selected records requires the role and a separate confirmation. Removing problematic messages does not fix an Android vulnerability.
Offline • No telemetry • No message contents or PDUs read • Results kept only in memory

SmsOfLife is not an SMS/MMS client. While it is the default, incoming SMS/MMS are not saved by this app and may be lost or not received correctly. Sending and quick replies are unavailable.

The role is requested only to delete records you selected. It does not guarantee write access. Nothing will be deleted until you review the IDs and confirm separately after returning here.

Your current SMS app will be recorded before Android asks for approval. Keep this period brief, then restore that app in Default apps. Uninstalling does not guarantee restoration.

Deleting these pending-message records can permanently lose messages or message parts. A suspicious indicator is not proof of malicious content. There is no undo in this app.

The app will re-read all selected records and stop if their metadata has changed. Android may mark rows deleted instead of removing them physically. A multi-record operation may finish only partially if access or provider behavior changes.

Cleanup verified for the selected IDs: all are now absent or marked deleted. This does not confirm that phone-service crashes are fixed or that Android is no longer vulnerable.

The provider returned an unexpected change count for a single ID. Further deletion stopped. Do not assume that cleanup succeeded; restore your previous SMS app.

The final query could not verify every selected ID. Cleanup is not confirmed. Restore your previous SMS app before leaving.
The local operation summary could not be saved reliably. The operation was stopped or its result could not be retained. Review any available counts; restore your previous SMS app and scan again.

The operation was interrupted or its result was lost. Some deletions may have happened. No deletion will resume automatically, and cleanup cannot be confirmed. Restore your previous SMS app, then scan again if needed.
